prompts.name: Stepped octagon
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: selectable pommel design for an ornate AAA fantasy spear. Generate ONE distinct, beautifully refined physically plausible pommel concept, not a collage. Input image 1 is the existing REJECTED pommel: use only its dark red rosewood shaft diameter and aged warm gold material, DO NOT copy its long fluted sleeve or raised straight rails. The new design must fit onto that same 32mm diameter round wooden shaft. Present only a short piece of the wood entering from upper-left and the new complete gold pommel extending lower-right, consistent three-quarter product camera, entire pommel fully visible with generous margin. Charcoal near-black studio backdrop, soft neutral studio illumination revealing bevels and fine engraving, realistic PBR gold with subtle fine wear and restrained patina, polished bevels but no mirror chrome. Solid manufacturable forms suitable for efficient game geometry and simple collision; modest ornament, no gems, no additional materials, no floating parts, no tassels, no spearhead, no weapon text or branding. Blunt terminal, not a stabbing spike. Maintain believable scale: pommel overall 60–125mm long and generally 34–50mm wide, except intentionally wider small disks. Avoid excessive decorative clutter. Design 01 — Stepped octagon: A compact eight-sided ferrule with two broad chamfered shoulders, a small flat blunt heel, and one recessed angular meander band. Restrained architectural solid form; no long raised rails. Typography: a small clear light-gray label '01 — Stepped octagon' at the bottom-left, outside the object. High-end concept render suitable for later Blender modeling.
